description:
Nothing short of a dream to be able to present to you one of the finest ballads created, 'A Fool For You' by Chicago's own Ledgends, licensed directly from bandleader Herbert McCormick alongside the song he approved a sample for for Madlib Invazion - Freddie Gibbs and Madlib's "Deeper", presented here as an instrumental, and originally released on the Piñata album. 

Utmost respect and gratitude goes to Egon @nowagain for his continual perseverance to highlight the exceptional artistry and give a voice to those lesser-known soul groups of yesteryear whilst inspiring contemporary culture with these timeless & sentimental sounds. Thank you for making this happen
